caption: The drawing depicts a single object resembling a lantern or a decorative glass container mounted on a stand. The container is polygonal, almost hexagonal, with transparent or glass-like panels outlined in thin metal edges, and is topped with a metallic, domed lid that has small ornamental projections and spiked decorations on its top edges. The container is supported by a vertical, cylindrical post that is attached to a broad, round base, which appears to be made of metal with a slightly reflective, greenish-gray hue. The overall composition places the object centrally against a plain, off-white background. The drawing employs soft shading and subtle color variations, primarily in shades of green, gray, and blue, to create a realistic effect. In the lower right corner, the name "TR BUKER" is written in small, greenish capital letters.
title: Lantern
